Morgan Stanley is a global financial services firm seeking an Associate, Software Engineer to develop and maintain enterprise-level applications. The role focuses on Java and microservices, distributed systems, cloud-native technologies, knowledge graphs, data pipelines, and DevOps practices across the software development lifecycle.

Responsibilities
Develop and maintain enterprise-level applications using Java and microservices architecture
Work with distributed systems, relational databases, and cloud-native technologies to deliver scalable solutions
Collaborate with cross-functional agile teams throughout the full software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering to deployment and maintenance
Implement data modeling solutions and work with knowledge graph technologies to support business intelligence and analytics initiatives
Utilize DevOps practices, continuous integration tools, and automation scripting to ensure efficient development workflows
Work in Linux environments with middleware technologies and containerized applications to build robust, high-performance systems

Collaborating in Agile teams using DevOps tools and practices for automated testing and deployment
Building cloud-native applications using Docker containers
Automating tasks and workflows using Python scripting
Implementing Knowledge Graphs using Stardog
Utilizing Grafana and Splunk for observability and monitoring
Maintaining CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins and GitLab CI; and
Designing and developing ETL pipelines for structured and semi-structured data
